shipping: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Shipping is free for orders over $50.
returns: Items can be returned within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.
refunds: Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
payments: We accept credit cards, debit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Cash on delivery is available for orders under $100.
